newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady to lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady to lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels in bids and offers on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- One barge, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, this week, bid 135 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, no bid, offer 115 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, no comparison, offer 105 percent, no comparison.
- Five barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, one each week of June, bid 135 percent, unchanged from May 29, no offer.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of July, bid 105 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from May 29, similar, offer 115 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from May 29, similar.
- Eight barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 132-1/2 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from May 29, no offer.
